[[File:Narissa.png|thumb|250px|Narissa]] '''Narissa''' (Japanese: '''マキナ''' ''Makina''), nicknamed '''Rissa''', is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP173|Dealing With a Fierce Double Ditto Drama!]]''. Narissa is a beginning [[Pokémon Trainer]] who owns two {{p|Ditto}}: one with regular coloration and one that is {{Shiny}}. She also owns an orange-colored [[Pokédex]]. According to her, she is called the "Rumbler" where she comes from. Upon meeting {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, Narissa seemed incredibly full of herself, calling Ash a "{{wp|Newbie|noob}}" Trainer before proudly announcing that she had been a Trainer for one month. She additionally claimed that she had no [[Badge]]s because the [[Gym Leader]]s would run in fear of her Ditto. Also, when she was about to participate with her Ditto in a [[Double Battle]] against a Trainer's {{p|Cubone}} and {{p|Marowak}}, Narissa had them both take the form of a passing {{p|Zapdos}}, causing the Trainer and his Pokémon to run in fear. Despite this tough and confident facade, however, Narissa is actually quite meek and self-conscious, as well as being a crybaby. She cosplays as [[Flint]] of the [[Sinnoh]] [[Elite Four]], whom she greatly admires, in order to help her feel more sure of herself. ==Pokémon== This listing is of Narissa's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Narissa |pkmn=Ditto |nick=Ditto 1 |type1=Normal |img=Ditto Number 1.png |epnum=DP173 |epname=Dealing With a Fierce Double Ditto Drama! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc=Narissa's first {{p|Ditto}}, [[nickname]]d Ditto 1 (Japanese: '''メタモン１号''' ''Metamon Ichigō''), is of normal coloration, and first appeared to the gang when it transformed into {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, {{AP|Gible}}, and {{TP|Dawn|Togekiss}} and caused mischief until Narissa turned up. Ditto was later used in battle against Pikachu, however despite being able to use Pikachu's powerful moves (like {{m|Iron Tail}} and {{m|Volt Tackle}}), it was easily defeated. {{TRT}} later attempted to steal both Narissa's Ditto, however they escaped and teamed up with Ash's Pikachu and sent Team Rocket blasting off with a triple-{{m|Thunderbolt}}. Ditto 1's only move is {{m|Transform}}.
Ditto 1 has also used {{m|Thunderbolt}}{{tt|*|Ash's Pikachu's}}, {{m|Iron Tail}}{{tt|*|Ash's Pikachu's}}, {{m|Volt Tackle}}{{tt|*|Ash's Pikachu's}}, {{m|Pound}}{{tt|*|Brock's Happiny's}}, {{m|Hammer Arm}}{{tt|*|Brock's Sudowoodo's}}, {{m|Aerial Ace}}{{tt|*|Ash's Staraptor's}}, {{m|Quick Attack}}{{tt|*|Ash's Staraptor's}}, and {{m|Poison Jab}}{{tt|*|Brock's Croagunk's}} via Transform.}} {{TrainerPoké |Trainer=Narissa |pkmn=Ditto |nick=Ditto 2 |shiny=yes |type1=Normal |img=Ditto Number 2.png |epnum=DP173 |epname=Dealing With a Fierce Double Ditto Drama! |vajp=Kiyotaka Furushima |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc=Narissa also owns a {{Shiny}} Ditto, nicknamed Ditto 2 (Japanese: '''メタモン２号''' ''Metamon Nigō''). After joining its regular counterpart in causing mischief, Ash battled the Shiny Ditto with {{AP|Infernape}}. In turn, Ditto {{m|transform}}ed into an {{p|Infernape}} itself. After trading a series of {{m|Mach Punch}}es, the round ended in Ash's favor. Later, the Shiny Ditto helped Ash {{ashfr}} foil another Team Rocket scheme. Ditto 2's only move is {{m|Transform}}.
Ditto 2 has also used {{m|Flame Wheel}}{{tt|*|Ash's Infernape's}}, {{m|Mach Punch}}{{tt|*|Ash's Infernape's}}, {{m|Pound}}{{tt|*|Brock's Happiny's}}, {{m|Hammer Arm}}{{tt|*|Brock's Sudowoodo's}}, {{m|Aerial Ace}}{{tt|*|Ash's Staraptor's}}, {{m|Dig}}{{tt|*|Ash's Gible's}}, {{m|Thunderbolt}}{{tt|*|Ash's Pikachu's}}, and {{m|Poison Jab}}{{tt|*|Brock's Croagunk's}} via Transform.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ditto egg color}}|bordercolor={{ditto egg color light}} |cs=Kateřina Petrová |de=Katharina Iacobescu |ja=沖佳苗 ''Kanae Oki'' |fr_eu=Cécile Florin |es_la=Carla Castañeda |en=[[Lisa Ortiz]] |fi=Taru Tikkanen |it=Benedetta Ponticelli |pt_br=Tatiane Keplmair |pl=Agnieszka Fajlhauer |es_eu=Emma Jiménez}} ==Trivia== * Narissa is somewhat similar to [[Duplica]], having two {{p|Ditto}} (with one of them being somewhat special) and cosplaying. * Narissa is one of the few females who have fallen in love with Brock, although this was temporary. * Narissa was named '''Marina''' on [[Pokémon.com]]. * Ditto 1 and 2's Japanese nicknames may be a reference to the original two heroes of the ''{{wp|Kamen Rider Series|Kamen Rider}}'' {{wp|tokusatsu}} franchise, Kamen Rider Ichigō and Kamen Rider Nigō. * Narissa's English [[dub]] name may be a reference to ''narcissist'', which relates to the level of her initial ego and elitism. * In the {{pmin|Finland|Finnish}} dub, Narissa speaks {{wp|Helsinki slang}}. {{-}} {{Project COD notice}} [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Sinnoh characters of the day]] [[Category:Trainers with Shiny Pokémon]] [[Category:Normal-type Trainers]] [[es:Narissa]] [[fr:Nastasia]] [[it:Narissa]] [[ja:マキナ]] [[zh:瑪姬娜]]
